user.title: Set up NIBE Local REST API
user.description: Choose the connection and authentication method. Credentials are requested in the next step for the selected method only.

data_description.password: The password is shown as a masked value.
data_description.auth_header: Complete HTTP Authorization header, for example “Basic dXNlcjpwYXNzd29ydA==”. The value after “Basic” must be Base64 encoded and is shown as a masked value.

reauth_confirm.title: NIBE Local REST API – update credentials
reauth_confirm.description: {device_name} – Host: {host} – IP: {ip_address} rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current credentials. Leave the secret field empty to keep the stored value.

data_description.auth_header: Complete HTTP Authorization header, for example “Basic dXNlcjpwYXNzd29ydA==”. The value after “Basic” must be Base64 encoded and is shown as a masked value.

entity_profile.title: Choose entity scope
entity_profile.description: Choose the entity scope and naming. Available on this device: Standard {standard}, Extended {extended}, Complete {complete}; Individual offers {individual} variables. Home Assistant continues to determine the final entity ID format.

data_description.entity_naming:
Controls which display name the integration provides to Home Assistant:
• Home Assistant standard (recommended): translated, easy-to-read names, e.g. “Outdoor temperature (BT1)”.
• Local API: name/description directly from the local NIBE API, e.g. “Current outdoor temperature (BT1)”.
• Technical: API name plus variable ID, e.g. “Current outdoor temperature (BT1) [ID 4]”.

entity_selection.title: Choose entities individually
entity_selection.description: {count} variables were discovered on the NIBE. Tick or untick the entities you want. Known points are shown with name, variable ID and unit.

auth_basic.title: Username + password
auth_basic.description: Enter the credentials for the local REST API.

auth_header.title: Authorization header
auth_header.description: Enter the complete HTTP Authorization header for the local REST API.

init.title: Configure NIBE Local REST API
init.description: Change connection, polling, entity profile, naming, and authentication method. Credentials are requested in the next step for the selected method only. Registry cleanup is optional. When cleanup is enabled, creating a backup first is enabled by default and must be explicitly disabled to delete without a backup.
